item.title: NHL roundup: DeBrincat nets team-high 26th goal in OT, Red Wings tip Senators 4-3
item.description: DETROIT (AP) — Alex DeBrincat scored 36 seconds into overtime to give the surging Detroit Red Wings a 4-3 win over the Ottawa Senators on Sunday. Axel Sandin-Pellikka, Lucas Raymond and James van Riemsdyk also scored for Detroit.

item.title: China's economy grows 5% in 2025, buoyed by strong exports despite Trump's tariffs
item.description: HONG KONG (AP) — China's economy expanded at a 5% annual pace in 2025, buoyed by strong exports despite U.S. President Donald Trump's tariffs. However, growth slowed to a 4.5% rate in the last quarter of the year, the government said Monday.

item.title: Luka, LeBron get Lakers back into form in 110-93 victory over Raptors
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — Luka Doncic had 25 points and seven assists, LeBron James added 24 points and seven assists, and the Los Angeles Lakers returned to form with a 110-93 victory over the Toronto Raptors on Sunday night.

item.title: Prince Harry returns to court in battle with British tabloids
item.description: LONDON (AP) — Millions of dollars are on the line as Prince Harry returns to court this week for the third and final chapter that starts Monday in his legal quest to tame the British tabloids.

item.title: U.S. women strike gold with 2-0 win over Canada in U18 world hockey championship
item.description: SYDNEY — Canada's unbeaten run at the Under-18 women's world hockey championship came to an end Sunday. Unfortunately, the impressive streak was halted in the gold-medal game against the United States.
